cards.name: Otherworldly Weakness
cards.text: Revelation - Put Otherworldly Weakness into play in your threat area. You get -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility]. Treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as [auto_fail]. [action]: Test [willpower](2) or [combat](2). If you succeed, discard Otherworldly Weakness.
